summary:
user: It is too expensive for me.
assistant: I understand. A 3 kW rooftop system costs 1,95,000 rupees before the government subsidy of 78,000 rupees, so you would pay 1,17,000 rupees. Would you like me to book your free site survey now?
user: No, it is still too expensive for us.
assistant: We also have EMI available from 2,999 rupees per month for 48 months.
user: Okay, what is the monthly EMI again?
assistant: The monthly EMI is 2,999 rupees per month for 48 months.
user: Fine, book the free survey. My name is Kiran, I live in Velachery, Saturday works.
